+package compiler.valhalla.valuetypes;
+
+import jdk.test.lib.Asserts;
+
+/*
+ * @test
+ * @bug 8396669
+ * @summary Test that a value class ConstantDynamic is scalarized.
+ * @requires vm.compiler2.enabled
+ * @library /test/lib
+ * @enablePreview
+ * @compile TestValueClassConstantDynamicHelper.jasm
+ * @run main ${test.main.class}
+ * @run main/othervm -XX:-TieredCompilation -Xbatch
+ *                   -XX:CompileCommand=compileonly,*::test
+ *                   ${test.main.class}
+ */
+public class TestValueClassConstantDynamic {
+    public static void main(String[] args) {
+        for (int i = 0; i < 20_000; i++) {
+            Asserts.assertEQ(TestValueClassConstantDynamicHelper.test((i & 1) == 0), 42);
+        }
+    }
+}
